newTabHint: Enter a URL or search term in the address bar
allowAgentAccess: Allow this conversation to control this page
agentAccessRequiresSession: This is a new conversation draft. Create a conversation before granting access. Manual browsing still works, and this button does not create a conversation.
clearHistoryDescription: This will delete all browsing history. This cannot be undone.
deleteHistoryDescription: The selected history entries will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
clearDownloadsDescription: Completed download records will be removed. Downloaded files will not be deleted.
missingDescription: This file was moved or deleted.
failed: The browser action failed. Please try again.
tabLimitReached: The browser tab limit is {{maxOpenTabs}} ({{openTabCount}} currently open). Close a tab and try again.
quitBlocked: Download history could not be saved, so quitting was cancelled. Check disk space or folder permissions, then try quitting again.
crashed: This page stopped responding. Reload it to continue.
sharedCacheDescription: Clear the cache shared by all browser tabs and conversations. Login sessions are preserved.
sharedSiteDataDescription: Clear cookies and site storage shared by all browser tabs and conversations. This signs you out of websites and also removes the saved cookie backup.
